## 💡 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific workout workflow or problem?
*(e.g., "When tracking Romanian Deadlifts, I want to automatically calculate weight progression based on my RPE.")*

## 🔬 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working:
- UI flow
- Voice command permutations (if voice-controlled)
- Mathematical / algorithmic logic (if progression-based)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.
